An '''engine binder''' was a [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-binded [[Engine/Legends|engine]] support frame used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]].

==History==
[[Vek Drow/Legends|Vek Drow]] gave [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] an engine binder after Qui-Gon rescued him from a group trying to rob his store. Qui-Gon was then able to trade the engine binder for a [[mass coupler]] or a [[servo control system]], which were both needed to fix [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]].

Qui-Gon could also obtain the engine binder by killing Vek Drow and stealing it from him.
